findings.issue: 3cp וְיָדְעוּ has מִצְרַיִם as subject of כִּי (Egypt knows that I am Jehovah). Plural conocerán with singular Egipto makes Egipto the object and an unnamed they the subject.
Niphal cohortative is smoothed to an indicative reflexive future, dropping the volitive force.

notes: Verbless כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה has no unmarked copula; wayyiqtol וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן is past hicieron así.
